newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil stable.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur straight-run fuel oil stable.

text.p: NWE straight-run fuel oil prices were steady as cracked prices gained slightly but discussed premiums eased, traders said.
A Scandinavian trader was heard to have sold an E-4 cargo, containing 1.6 percent water, to a refiner at around $2 over the mean/mean/mean of published quotes, cif NWE.
This follows trade at mean/mean/mean +$2.50 earlier in the week and, for a lower water piece, at mean/mean/mean +$3.75.
"I think premiums to the formula will come off because it is not looking so good against crude now," one regular buyer of cargoes said.
Russian exports continue apace and dealers said they expected February's output from the Baltics to exceed those of January.
